external_id.description: Your own identifier for the transaction, as supplied when it was recorded.

promo_total.description: Sum of line-item totals after promotions are applied.

receipt_type.description: How the shopper took their receipt, or null when they took none.

refund_total.description: Total value refunded against this transaction.

refunds.description: Refunds of the transaction. Retrieve one with `GET /v1/transactions/{id}` for the products returned and how the money went back.

retail_total.description: Sum of line-item retail totals after promotions and before discounts and tax.

shopper_facing_id.description: Human-readable transaction identifier shown to the shopper.

shopper_id.description: ID of the loyalty shopper associated with the transaction, or null for an anonymous transaction.

started_at.description: Date and time when the cashier started the transaction.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the transaction.

store_id.description: ID of the store where the transaction was placed.

subtotal.description: Sum of line-item subtotals before promotions, discounts, and tax.

tax_total.description: Total tax charged on the transaction.

taxable_amount.description: Portion of the transaction subject to tax.

total.description: Final transaction amount including tax. Sales are positive and refunds are negative.

total_collected.description: Total collected from the shopper, including the transaction total, tip, and cash back.

type.description: Financial transaction type represented by the transaction.

amount.description: Amount loaded onto the gift card.

gift_card_id.description: ID of the associated GiftCard that was funded by this sale. This value may be `null` if the sale was made while the POS was offline, and the transaction has not yet been back-filled.

TransactionGiftCardSale.description: A gift card purchased on a transaction, with the amount loaded onto it and links to the gift card and the transaction that funded it.

coupon_code.description: Coupon code the shopper presents to redeem the coupon on a later transaction.

coupon_id.description: ID of the coupon that was issued.

ended_at.description: Date and time after which the coupon can no longer be redeemed.

offer_benefit_value.description: Value of the coupon to the shopper when redeemed.

snap_incentive_program_id.description: ID of the SNAP incentive program the coupon was issued under.

started_at.description: Date and time from which the coupon can be redeemed.

TransactionIssuedCoupon.description: A coupon issued to the shopper by a transaction, with its code, benefit value, and the window in which it can be redeemed.

coupon_total.description: Total savings from coupons on this line.

department_id.description: ID of the department the product is assigned to.

discount_total.description: Total savings from manual and employee discounts on this line.

discounts.description: Manual and employee discounts applied to this line.

ebt_tax_waived_total.description: Tax waived on this line because the product was paid for with EBT.

free_quantity.description: Portion of the quantity on this line given away free by a promotion.

item_modifier_total.description: Total of the fees and deposits charged on this line, such as bottle deposits and container redemption fees.

item_modifiers.description: Fees and deposits charged on this line, such as bottle deposits, container redemption fees, and bag fees.

loyalty_rewards.description: Loyalty rewards redeemed against this line.

loyalty_rewards_total.description: Total savings from loyalty reward redemptions on this line.

promo_savings.description: Total savings from promotions on this line.

quantity.description: Number of units sold on this line, or the weight sold for products priced by weight.

refunded_order_line_item_id.description: ID of the original sale line this refund line returns, or null when this line is not a refund.

retail_price.description: Shelf price per unit before promotions, coupons, and discounts.

retail_total.description: Line total after promotions are applied, before discounts and tax.

subtotal.description: Retail price multiplied by quantity, before promotions, discounts, and tax.

tax_total.description: Total sales tax charged on this line.

taxable_amount.description: Portion of this line that is subject to tax.

taxes.description: Sales taxes charged on this line.

total.description: Final amount for this line, including tax. Positive on a sale and negative on a refund.

type.description: Whether this line was sold, refunded, or voided.

variable_weights.description: Weight readings recorded for this line when the product is sold by weight.

wic_adjusted_price.description: Price per unit the shopper paid under WIC, or null when WIC was not applied to this line.

TransactionLineItem.description: A product sold on a transaction, with its quantity, price, and totals, plus the coupons, discounts, loyalty rewards, promotions, fees, taxes, and weight readings recorded against it.

applied_amount.description: Savings the coupon produced on this line item.

coupon_code.description: Coupon code that was scanned or entered at checkout.

coupon_id.description: ID of the coupon that was redeemed.

offer_display_text.description: Offer text shown on the receipt for the coupon.

offer_id.description: ID of the offer the coupon came from.

TransactionLineItemCoupon.description: A coupon redeemed against a line of a transaction, with the savings it produced and the offer it came from.

applied_amount.description: Savings the discount produced on this line item.

discount_id.description: ID of the discount that was applied, or null when the cashier entered a one-off discount.

discount_name.description: Name of the discount shown to the cashier and on the receipt.

discount_type.description: How the discount is calculated: a percentage off or a fixed amount off.

discount_value.description: Configured value of the discount, such as 10 for 10% off or 1.50 for $1.50 off.

TransactionLineItemDiscount.description: A discount applied to a line of a transaction, with its name, type, configured value, and the savings it produced.

applied_amount.description: Savings the loyalty reward produced on this line item.

loyalty_reward_id.description: ID of the loyalty reward that was redeemed.

loyalty_reward_name.description: Name of the loyalty reward at the time it was redeemed.

offer_id.description: ID of the offer associated with the loyalty reward.

order_loyalty_reward_id.description: ID of the transaction-level reward redemption this line item draws from.

TransactionLineItemLoyaltyReward.description: A loyalty reward redeemed against a line of a transaction, with the savings it produced and the offer it came from.

amount.description: Amount charged for the fee or deposit on this line item.

item_modifier_id.description: ID of the fee or deposit that was charged, such as a bottle deposit or CRV.

quantity.description: Number of units of the fee or deposit charged on this line item.

tax_amount.description: Tax charged on the fee or deposit.

taxes.description: Taxes charged on the fee or deposit.

TransactionLineItemModifier.description: A fee or deposit charged on a line of a transaction, with the amount, quantity, and tax collected on it.

id.description: ID of the product in your store's catalog.

barcode.description: UPC or PLU recorded for the product when it was sold, whether it was scanned or entered by hand.

ebt_enabled.description: Whether the product can be paid for with EBT.

name.description: Name of the product as it was sold.

sold_by_weight.description: Whether the product is priced by weight rather than by unit.

unit_of_measure.description: Unit of measure the size is expressed in, such as oz or lb.

unit_of_measure_amount.description: Size of the product in its unit of measure, such as 12 for a 12 oz can.

wic_enabled.description: Whether the product can be paid for with WIC.

amount.description: Portion of the line the promotion applied to.

display_text.description: Text shown for the promotion on the receipt.

offer_id.description: ID of the offer the promotion belongs to.

promotion_id.description: ID of the promotion that produced the savings.

savings.description: Amount the promotion took off the line.

amount.description: Tax charged on this line item.

tax_rate.description: Tax rate that produced the charge, as it was configured when the transaction was completed.

variable_weight.description: Tare container weight subtracted from the scale reading, as it was recorded at the time of sale.

authorized_amount.description: Amount authorized for this payment, which is less than the requested amount on a partial approval.

cash_received.description: Cash handed over by the shopper, or null for non-cash payments.

change_returned.description: Change given back to the shopper, or null for non-cash payments.

terminal_was_online.description: Indicates if the payment terminal was online when the payment was authorized. This will be `null` for non-card payments.

amount.description: Discount value as a decimal string. For `amount_off`, this is in major/minor currency units (for example, "1.25"). For `percentage_off`, this is a whole-number percentage (`"1.00"` means 1%).

name.description: Human-readable discount name, or null when the discount is unnamed.

type.description: How `amount` is applied: as a fixed monetary reduction or a percentage reduction.

authentication_rule.description: How the employee signs in at the point of sale, or null to sign in with a PIN. Every method the rule names must have its credential set on the employee.

badge_barcode.description: Barcode on the badge the employee scans to sign in at the point of sale, or null for none. Unique within the banner. A deactivated employee cannot hold one unless the same request reactivates them.

deactivated_at.description: When the employee was deactivated. Null means active, so setting it back to null reactivates the employee. Deactivating releases the employee's PIN and barcode so another employee can take them.

email_address.description: Employee's email address, or null for none. Unique within the banner.

pin.description: Numeric PIN the employee enters to sign in at the point of sale, or null for none. Six digits, and unique within the banner. A deactivated employee cannot hold one unless the same request reactivates them.

roles.description: Roles the employee holds. Supplying this replaces every role the employee holds.

UpdateEmployeeRequest.description: Values for updating an employee. An omitted property is left unchanged, and an explicit null clears a property that permits one.

name.description: The role to grant.

store_id.description: The store the role applies at, or null to apply it at every store in the banner.

UpdateEmployeeRole.description: A role to grant an employee, and the store it applies at.

employee_id.description: ID of the employee responsible. Only a register sends one, and it is required there; a back-office session records the signed-in user, and an API credential records itself.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to avoid duplicate transactions.

magstripe_account_numbers.description: The desired end state of which magnetic-stripe account numbers (physical gift cards) are associated with the specified gift card. If this field is not provided, no account numbers will be modified.

owner_phone_number.description: Phone number of the Shopper who will own this gift card. This shopper will receive messages about this and future transactions.

physical_barcodes.description: The desired end state of which barcodes (physical gift cards) are associated with the specified gift card. If this field is not provided, no barcodes will be modified.

email.description: Email address on file for the account holder.

name.description: Name the account is held under, usually the customer or business it belongs to.

phone_number.description: Phone number on file for the account holder.

shopper_facing_id.description: Account number the store gives the customer, and what a cashier looks the account up by. Unique within the banner.

name.description: Human-readable item modifier name.

price_tag_label.description: Optional shelf-tag classification for bottle deposits or container redemption value.

tax_behavior.description: Whether the modifier is excluded from tax or inherits the product tax behavior.

type.description: Business purpose of the item modifier.

value.description: Monetary value of the modifier as a decimal string in major/minor currency units.

email_address.description: Email address on file for the shopper.

enrolled_in_loyalty_program.description: Whether the shopper is enrolled in the loyalty program. Shoppers must explicitly opt into the loyalty program, typically at the POS. Digital gift card recipients are also stored as shoppers, but are only opted into the loyalty program after giving explicit permission.

phone_number.description: Phone number on file for the shopper, and what a loyalty member gives at checkout to be identified.

postal_code.description: Postal code on file for the shopper.

deactivated_at.description: When the department was deactivated. Null means active, so setting it reactivates the department.

exclude_from_sales_reporting.description: Whether sales from this department are omitted from sales reporting.

name.description: Human-readable department name.

parent_department_id.description: ID of the parent department, or null for a top-level department. A parent must itself be top-level: departments nest one level deep.

disable_barcode_sanitization.description: When true, the barcode is stored verbatim and the product's `barcode_type` is set to `Unsanitized`. When false, an existing `Unsanitized` product is re-sanitized on save. When omitted, the existing `barcode_type` is preserved (partial updates are safe).

shelf_life_days.description: Shelf life in days sent to deli scales (Hobart, eplum, Ishida); the scale computes the sell-by date from it. 1-999, or null for no Vori-managed shelf life.

is_primary.description: Set true to make this the primary location (demotes the current primary). Setting false on the current primary is rejected — promote another shelf location instead.

section.description: Bay/section within the aisle (e.g. "Bay 3", "Left"). Pass null to clear.

shelf.description: Shelf level within the section. Pass null to clear.

UpdateStoreProductPlacementRequest.description: Changes to a shelf location, such as moving it to a different aisle, section, or shelf, or promoting it to the primary location.

active.description: Whether the rate is charged at checkout. An inactive rate stays configured but is not applied.

category.description: The kind of tax this rate represents.

name.description: Name of the tax rate, such as the jurisdiction that levies it or the category it covers.

value.description: The rate charged. When `value_type` is `percentage`, this is a percentage of the taxable amount — `8.25` means 8.25%. When it is `amount`, this is a fixed amount of currency charged per unit sold.

value_type.description: How `value` is applied: a fixed amount or a percentage.

name.description: Human-readable name for the tare container, such as "Produce bag".

unit_of_measure.description: Unit of measure the weight is expressed in, limited to the units the point of sale can weigh in.

value.description: Weight of the tare container, as a decimal string in the unit of measure.

inventory.description: The change to make to the on-hand quantity. Omit it to update only the reorder levels.

max_stock.description: The most of this product the store wants on hand. Send null to clear it; omit it to leave it as it is.

min_par.description: The on-hand quantity at which the product should be reordered. Send null to clear it; omit it to leave it as it is.

store_product_selection_criteria.description: Criteria used to select products whose inventory will be updated.

UpsertStoreProductInventoryRequest.description: The products to update, and the reorder levels or on-hand quantity to write to them.

updated_count.description: How many products the request updated.

UpsertStoreProductInventoryResponse.description: The outcome of an inventory update. The updated products are not returned.

name.description: Human-readable name for the tare container, such as "Produce bag".

store_id.description: ID of the store the variable weight belongs to. Variable weights are not shared between stores.

unit_of_measure.description: Unit of measure the weight is expressed in, limited to the units the point of sale can weigh in.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed.

value.description: Weight of the tare container, as a decimal string in the unit of measure.

VariableWeight.description: The weight of a tare container a product is sold in, such as a produce bag. It is subtracted from the scale reading so the shopper pays for the contents rather than the packaging.
